qualification.details: JRF: B.Tech/ MSc/MCA with proficiency in web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). Experience in web development or related field for at least 1 year. Fresher can also apply. JRF (GATE) V2: Postgraduate degree/ Advance degree in the relevant field. Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering/ Computer Science/Data Science, Civil engineering/ MCA. Valid NET/GATE score required. JRF (GATE) V1: Postgraduate degree in the relevant field. Bachelor’s degree in Grass Root Technology/ Rural Technology/ Biotechnology/ Mechanical Engineering/ Civil Engineering/ Chemical Engg/ Basic Science and allied field. Valid NET/GATE score required. JRF (GATE) V4: Postgraduate degree in the relevant field. Bachelor’s degree in Material Science/ Polymer Science/ Mechanical Engineering/ Chemical Engineering/ Basic Science and allied field. Valid NET/GATE score required. CA/CS/Accountant: Qualified Chartered Accountant/M.Com with minimum 2 years of core experience in indirect Taxes particularly in GST in running a company. Practical experience of handling startup business impact assessment and IT impact assessment preferred. Experience in accounting. Business Development Officer: Bachelor/Masters/ MBA/PhD degree. Experience in handling HR functions/ Business administration/ Organization Development in project environments for at least 2 years. Demonstrated experience in organizing and conducting online and offline training programs. Technical Assistant: B.Sc / B.A/ B.Com. Multimedia and animation work experience in Photoshop and illustrator will be given preference. Diploma in Graphic Design, Print and Web publishing. Expert in Social Media handling. Computer knowledge is essential. Office Assistant: Bachelor's degree/ 10+2. Diploma holders will be desirable. Computer knowledge is essential. Basic office skills, experience for at least two years for working in similar organization. Office Attendant: 10+2/Diploma. Basic office skills, experience for at least one year for working in similar organization. LMV Driving Skills are desirable for one post.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Guwahati Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies released by IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: IIT Guwahati has released a total of 12 vacancies for various posts including JRF, Technical Assistant, Office Assistant, and Office Attendant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for IIT Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The tentative date for the walk-in interview is 05 August 2026. Candidates are advised to confirm the exact timings and venue from the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the JRF posts?
faq.answer: For JRF posts, qualifications range from B.Tech/MSc/MCA to Postgraduate degrees, with specific requirements like NET/GATE scores for some positions.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for IIT Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the JRF posts?
faq.answer: The salary for JRF posts varies, with some positions offering up to Rs. 44910.00 per month, while others offer Rs. 23198.00 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for all the advertised posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q10. Does IIT Guwahati offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to check the official PDF for any such information.
